WITH rev AS (SELECT SUM(rf.numeric_value) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS fact_count FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN sales_reports AS sr ON sr.id = rf.report_id WHERE rf.status = 'confirmed' AND sr.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.metric_key = 'revenue' AND rf.period_start >= '2026-09-01' AND rf.period_start <= '2026-09-30'), tgt AS (SELECT c.annual_sales_target, c.annual_sales_target_currency FROM contracts AS c WHERE c.status = 'active' ORDER BY c.effective_from DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) SELECT rev.revenue, rev.fact_count, tgt.annual_sales_target, tgt.annual_sales_target_currency, CASE WHEN NOT tgt.annual_sales_target IS NULL THEN rev.revenue / NULLIF(CAST((tgt.annual_sales_target ->> 'amount') AS DECIMAL), 0) END AS completion_ratio FROM rev, tgt

SELECT poi.product_name, poi.sku, SUM(poi.quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(poi.line_total) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM purchase_orders AS po JOIN purchase_order_items AS poi ON poi.po_id = po.id WHERE po.submitted_at >= '2026-09-01' AND po.submitted_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY poi.product_name, poi.sku ORDER BY poi.product_name, poi.sku LIMIT 100

WITH po AS (SELECT id FROM purchase_orders WHERE submitted_at >= '2026-08-01' AND submitted_at < '2026-10-01'), agg AS (SELECT p.category, SUM(i.quantity) AS total_boxes, SUM(i.line_total) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM purchase_order_items AS i JOIN po ON i.po_id = po.id LEFT JOIN products AS p ON i.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.category) SELECT category, total_boxes, total_amount, line_count FROM agg ORDER BY category LIMIT 100

WITH sales AS (SELECT rf.sku, SUM(rf.numeric_value) AS units_sold, COUNT(*) AS fact_count FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN sales_reports AS sr ON sr.id = rf.report_id WHERE sr.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.metric_key = 'units_sold' AND rf.period_start >= '2026-09-01' AND rf.period_end <= '2026-09-30' GROUP BY rf.sku) SELECT s.sku, p.product_name_en, p.product_name_native, s.units_sold, s.fact_count FROM sales AS s LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.sku = s.sku ORDER BY s.sku LIMIT 100
SELECT id, title, status, annual_sales_target, annual_sales_target_currency, term_start_date, term_end_date FROM contracts LIMIT 100
SELECT po_number, status, total_amount, eta_date FROM purchase_orders WHERE status <> 'completed' AND (submitted_at < '2026-10-01' OR submitted_at IS NULL) ORDER BY submitted_at LIMIT 100

WITH inv AS (SELECT rf.sku, rf.product_id, SUM(rf.numeric_value) AS stock_on_hand FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN sales_reports AS sr ON sr.id = rf.report_id WHERE sr.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.metric_key = 'stock_on_hand' AND rf.period_end >= '2026-09-01' AND rf.period_end <= '2026-09-30' GROUP BY rf.sku, rf.product_id) SELECT inv.sku, COALESCE(p.product_name_en, p.product_name_native) AS product_name, inv.stock_on_hand FROM inv LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.id = inv.product_id ORDER BY inv.sku LIMIT 100
